continuum.title: The Patient Journey
continuum.subtitle: Ensuring intelligence is never lost. PeriTwin is with the patient from intake through recovery.

stages.body: Synthesizing longitudinal history and clinical notes.

stages.title: OR / Procedure
stages.body: Real-time ambient capture of surgical technique.

stages.title: Post-op
stages.body: Tracking recovery milestones and discharge data.

wearable.title: Peri listens and observes in the room
wearable.body: Clinician-worn glasses capture the encounter as it happens: the conversation, the exam, what's on the screen. No dictation, no scribe in the corner. You look at the patient, and the room documents itself.
wearable.ledgerLabel: What leaves the room, and what never does
wearable.footer: Masking is verified and logged before anything uploads.

intelligence.title: Intelligence that learns from you
intelligence.subtitle: A generic scribe writes the same note for every surgeon. Peri learns your voice and carries each patient's story forward.

voice.title: It writes the way you write
voice.body: Every edit you make is a lesson. Peri picks up your phrasing, your exam order, your defaults, so the first draft sounds like you, not like a template.
voice.before: Range of motion is within functional limits.
voice.after: ROM 0–110°, symmetric to the contralateral side.

memory.title: It remembers the whole story
memory.body: Every encounter joins the patient's twin, so February's exam is still at hand in July, and nothing you documented gets lost between visits.

colleague.title: Your Digital Colleague
colleague.body: Peri serves as your clinical digital twin: a colleague to bounce ideas off for tough cases. It removes clinical isolation, decreases cognitive burden, and lets you return to the heart of medicine, patient care.

items.title: EHR integration
items.body: Findings flow into the systems you already run on. Peri writes structured notes back to Epic and Cerner, so the record reflects the encounter without a second pass of data entry at the end of your day.

items.title: Medico-legally robust
items.body: Every insight is traceable to the moment it was captured. Timestamped source media, clinician review before anything is signed, and an auditable trail from observation to documented finding.

philosophy.title: Built for doctors, by doctors.
philosophy.body: Our mission is to return the focus to patient-centered medicine. Join the community of clinicians reclaiming their practice through personalized digital intelligence.
philosophy.pilotLine: In pilot with surgical teams at CREOQ & CLLC in Montréal
